ZERO of them is unexplained.
residualEditWithoutRead.$countsComment: THREE NUMBERS, BECAUSE THE ACTIVATION HAS TWO HALVES AND ONLY ONE OF THEM IS A MIGRATION. 29 is the census on the tree BEFORE this change: the matrix R verbs unwired and the migration unwritten. 27 is the census with the matrix wiring applied and the migration NOT applied -- the two `employee` rows close on the WIRING ALONE, because employee.record.read is one of the few registered READ keys the LEGACY Role catalog also declares, so deriveObjectCred can satisfy it at seed time. The other three wired Objects cannot close that way, which is the structuralFinding below. 10 is the census after both halves. The test measures 27 -> 10 because a test can rerun the migration and cannot un-wire a committed matrix; 29 is recorded as the measurement it was.

structuralFinding.measured: policySeed.ts seeds role_object_permissions from `held = roleDefinitions[key].permissions` -- the in-repo LEGACY Role catalog arrays -- and not from eos_policy.role_capabilities. It cannot read the grants, because at seed time (rebuild phase B) role_capabilities is empty by construction. CONSEQUENCE: a capability registered by MIGRATION ALONE can never flip a freshly seeded CRED verb, however many Roles hold it. admin.securityPolicy.read has been in exactly that state since migration 1762041600000, and receivingOrder.record.read, workOrder.record.read and reportDefinition.read would join it.
structuralFinding.mitigationApplied: Migration 1762300800000 reconciles role_object_permissions for the five Objects it touches, setting can_read true ONLY where the Role already holds a registered READ capability on that Object -- so it changes no effective authority, it makes the stored projection agree with the grants. That fixes every database seeded BEFORE the migration, which is every real one.
structuralFinding.notFixed: A tenant seeded AFTER this migration still derives its CRED from the legacy arrays and will be born with can_read false on rolesPermissions, receivingOrder, workOrder and reportDefinition. The durable fix is to give the seed the governed grants as an input, which moves hundreds of projection rows and is an Owner decision, not a side effect of an activation.
